topic: who reads a README and when
prompt_markdown: A new volunteer opens the pantry folder and finds `crate.py` with a README beside it.
Which picture of the README is right?
hint: Picture someone who has never seen the code. What do they read first, and why?

options.text: The README is where they learn what the script does and how to run it, before reading any code.
They should read the code first; a README only repeats it.
The README is only useful to the person who wrote the script.
The README is a formality that tools require.
